metadata.title: Ensign - Controller Support
metadata.author: Leyla (jan-leila)
metadata.description: Full controller support for FTL through Steam Input: navigate your ship, the enemy ship, power, weapons, drones, crew and every menu with a gamepad or the Steam Deck. Requires Hyperspace and the Ensign native shim (ensign.amd64.so) preloaded before Hyperspace.
